package_name: Norton Ranch Blueprint — M5 Sovereign Agriculture Starter Package
license_state_notice: This package is a public-commons starter kit. Downloading or unpacking it does not create a licensed M5POD, an M5 account, a registered business entity, a credential, or any authority. It becomes part of a licensed M5POD only after the principal registers, the business entity is registered, and the M5 implementation tools are activated under applicable terms.

activation_required.name: Register the human principal
activation_required.detail: Create an M5IAM account and establish TCID / M5HUM identity.

activation_required.name: Reserve and activate a private M5POD
activation_required.detail: The M5POD holds private identity, evidence and operational data under the principal's authority.

activation_required.name: Record authority
activation_required.detail: Establish the principal's role and authority (M5-CV) for the farm or ranch entity.

activation_required.name: Register the farm or ranch business entity
activation_required.detail: Record the existing lawful entity (LLC, cooperative, partnership, trust, sole proprietorship or other) and its namespace and jurisdiction context. M5 registration does not replace government formation or other legal obligations.

activation_required.name: Activate the M5 farm tools
activation_required.detail: Activate the farm, herd, animal, device and assignment tools for the registered entity.

works_before_activation: Read all documentation, schemas and synthetic examples.
Run the local-only Sovereign Herd provisioning utility on your own herd file, with no network calls.
Plan farm, herd, animal and device records and test them against the published schemas.
Use the Farmer Toolkit registry to find free and public data starting points.
requires_activation: A licensed M5POD and business M5POD context.
Registered entity namespace and authority mapping.
Registry relationships, conformance manifests and public-safe provenance references.
Use of the M5 implementation tools for the registered entity.

restricted_content.notice: Founder family archive photographs are not covered by the repository open-content or open-code license grants. See the README in that folder.

non_claims: Not a licensed M5POD until registration and activation are complete.
Not production-ready and not a veterinary system.
No farmer, ranch, animal or device is claimed to be live on the system.
No collar vendor is claimed to be M5 certified.
